claim: MySQL8.4 plain whole-table COUNT(*) normally traverses the smallest available secondary index, otherwise clustered index; hints can change choice. Buffer-pool residency affects cost. COUNT(1) is handled equivalently.
use: Final guide integration: useful existing-index plan guidance on isolated acquisition target; do not create primary index or force primary as universal optimization.
boundary: Official8.4 semantics, not a measured performance or service SLO guarantee for all supported versions.
